text:
Sam: quick heads-up — pentest team goes live Mon 09:00 PT. We still need: RBAC rollback playbook, KMS evidence access flow, audit-log export verification, retest slot preferences. Can we do 30m scrub today?
Priya: I can do 30. Quick Q: are we giving them ephemeral admin or scoped reviewer roles? i'd vote scoped reviewer + jumpbox.
Marco: +1 scoped reviewer. Also need to confirm which KMS keys they'll access and whether we provide HSM-wrapped exports. Logged a note in the ticket.
Aisha: I can draft the rollback steps. Suggest: 1) revoke temporary reviewer role 2) rotate service principal creds used for assessor 3) verify audit logs captured for their window, then re-enable normal access.
Sam: draft sounds good. Marco — what are current log retention windows for staging vs prod? we need to ensure 30 days of raw event logs for the pentest window.
Marco: staging = 90d, prod = 365d. But some debug-level traces are 7d only. We should snapshot debug logs before the window. command I used for snapshotting:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/staging/ /tmp/pentest-logs --recursive --exclude "*DEBUG*"
```
Priya: For KMS: assessors need read-encrypt? we should create a temporary CMKAlias like alias/pt-assessor-2024 and grant Decrypt for the assessor IAM role. No key rotation during access window.
Maggie: note — if we give Decrypt on CMK, we must log Key Usage in CloudTrail and export key-event records. I'll add a CloudTrail lookup alert for that timeframe.
deploy-bot: deployment 2024-04-02T15:10:12Z: created IAM role sampler-pt-assessor (arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/sampler-pt-assessor)
Sam: good catch. Also need a pre-signed evidence upload path for them. Priya — can you provide a presigned URL process and retention TTL? Keep it 14 days and auto-delete.
Priya: sure. Example presigned generation snippet (python):
```
import boto3
s3 = boto3.client('s3')
url = s3.generate_presigned_url('put_object', Params={'Bucket':'redwood-pt-evidence','Key':'acme/scan.zip'}, ExpiresIn=1209600)
print(url)
```
Aisha: I'll add an ops checklist: pre-window snapshot, create alias key, grant scoped role, enable CloudTrail filter, upload presigned location, post-window revoke + rotate. I'll also add a step to store evidence hash in the artifacts bucket.
Sam: can we propose retest windows? pentest team requested 48h after fixes. Options: Tue 09:00 or Thu 14:00. please vote.
Marco: Tue 09:00 works for infra team.
Priya: Thu 14:00 better for app leads. leaning Thu.
Maggie: Thu 14:00 prefers — gives more time for audit export.
Sam: ok Thu 14:00 tentative. I'll update ticket and schedule the 30m scrub in 20m. thanks :thumbsup:
